calendarNotes: LPS begins with kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9 on August 12, then brings all K–12 students into session August 13. Labor Day on September 7 is followed by a professional learning/planning day September 8, so students return September 9. Quarter 1 ends October 14; the student break runs October 15–19 and Quarter 2 begins October 20. Thanksgiving no-school dates run November 25–27, followed by a professional learning/planning day November 30. Quarter 2 ends December 22, Semester Break runs December 23–January 3, January 4 is a professional learning/planning day and Quarter 3 begins January 5. Quarter 3 ends March 5, Spring Break runs March 8–12 and Quarter 4 begins March 15. The Middle School X/Y, Preschool and Full Day Preschool calendars are companion schedules and are not merged into the K–12 event list or ICS. LPS may revise minutes or days if weather-related lost time puts the year below state minimum school hours.

customSections.content: LPS uses two opening dates for the three main school transitions. Several no-school periods are extended by a professional learning/planning day, so students sometimes return later than the named holiday or break dates suggest.

customSections.label: Which LPS Calendar Applies to Your Student?
customSections.content: LPS publishes separate calendars for different kinds of planning. The Student Calendar covers districtwide K–12 dates, while middle-school X/Y rotations and preschool attendance are published separately. LPS says Early Childhood students begin classes August 18; families should use the preschool calendar that matches their program for program-specific attendance dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Do all LPS students start on August 12?
calendarFaqs.a: No. August 12 is the first day for kindergarten, grade 6 and grade 9. Students in the remaining K–12 grades begin August 13.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students return on January 4 after Semester Break?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Semester Break runs through January 3, and January 4 is a professional learning and planning day. Students return Tuesday, January 5.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the ICS include Middle School X/Y days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS covers selected districtwide K–12 dates. Use the official Middle School X/Y PDF for rotation days.

calendarFaqs.q: Which preschool calendar should I use?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the Preschool Calendar for the standard preschool schedule or the Full Day Preschool Calendar for that program. Neither schedule is included in the K–12 ICS.
